'''Warmaster''' was a title among the [[Flesh Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. [[Unidentified Flesh Raider Warmaster|A Warmaster]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Padawan]] in the [[Upper Hollows]] in order to get the Flesh Raider's key to the weapons cache nearby.
